ask: this is a mess fix it
sentence: A shared board of eight fixed household chores where each person claims one open chore at a time, marks it done, or releases it, and everyone sees who has what.
use_when: A group needs to split a fixed list of chores so each person takes one
Getting a shared home ready for an inspection or guests
Seeing at a glance which chores are open, taken, or done
Housemates need to sort out who does what without arguing
dont_use_when: The chore list needs to be edited, added to, or made custom
Chores need to repeat weekly or rotate on a schedule
One person should get several tasks or tasks are assigned by a leader
Tracking shared expenses or shopping money instead of tasks
